bot_settings.title: Bot safety
bot_settings.subtitle: Workspace-wide guardrails. Changes take effect immediately.
bot_settings.kill_switch_enabled: Bot is active across all flows
bot_settings.kill_switch_disabled: Bot is paused globally (kill switch active)
bot_settings.rate_limit_desc: Maximum automated messages per contact per minute to avoid spam flags.
bot_settings.max_conv_desc: Hard limit on messages in a single session before automatic termination.
bot_settings.spam_threshold_desc: Threshold of repeated or abnormal inputs that triggers safety shutdown.
bot_settings.running_desc: Inbound messages route to your active flows.
bot_settings.paused_desc: All inbound messages skip the engine and go to your inbox.
bot_settings.rate_limit_help: Drops bursts where a single number floods the bot. Counted in a 60-second sliding window.
bot_settings.max_conv_help: Hard cap that breaks runaway loops. Conversations are auto-ended when they cross this number of inbound messages.
bot_settings.spam_threshold_help: Each inbound message earns a heuristic score (URLs, repeated chars, length). At this total, the conversation is auto-ended and flagged as spam.
bot_settings.safety_desc: rate limit drops bursts before the engine runs. Per-conversation cap catches long-running loops. Spam threshold targets clearly malicious content. All three fail open — if anything misbehaves, the bot keeps working.
